summary: Shoshone County, Idaho platform lookout on the St. Joe National Forest, dated only to the 1930s and recorded as abandoned. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Recorded as abandoned, with no year given; no source says what remains at the site.

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts classes the site as a hike-in

evidence.supports: filed under the St. Joe - Clearwater region
location 45N-8E-23 (township, range, section) in page header

corrections.why: Every source describes the platform tower as abandoned; none says it was destroyed or removed, so gone is not supported

notes_for_editor: Story is about 109 words, under the 120-word floor, because the sources offer only the 1930s date and an undated abandonment; nothing was padded. An earlier draft said no source says whether the site is open to visitors; Idaho Fire Lookouts' Hike-In label contradicts that, so the story now states the label instead. Thin record: no source gives a year for the abandonment, so no events are listed. No staffing, fire or site-today information in any source read. Forest Lookouts gives the land location as 45N-8E-23. The brief's status gone is not supported; the proposed correction to abandoned is for human review. No photos found.
